name: Cold Coffee
steps: Dissolve the instant coffee and sugar in the small amount of hot water, then cool completely.
Put the chilled milk and cooled coffee mixture into a blender.
Blend for 15–20 seconds until evenly mixed and lightly frothy; taste and adjust sweetness.
Divide the ice among four glasses and pour the coffee over it.
Serve immediately while the froth remains airy. Keep the milk refrigerated until use.
tips: Serve freshly prepared. Adjust sweetness after tasting.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
